docs.text: The Veyra cold-room handbook says that purge_fast must not run while seal_mode is engaged. A single exception permits purge_fast during the signed frost-drill window; routine night shifts are not an exception.
Mira's adopted Nacre archive uses CedarDB. Ivo proposed RFC-K72 to switch the archive to FlintDB. Mira rejected RFC-K72 on 2026-04-17; the proposal was never adopted and CedarDB remains in use.
Lethra release 1 config sets worker_id to node-R7 and retry_mode to quorum-5.
Lethra release 2 changes only worker_id from node-R7 to node-T9. The retry_mode quorum-5 is unchanged; no other field is overridden.
The Orvi lab balance was not tared: the empty vessel read 218.5 g, after resin it read 643.75 g, and after solvent it read 901.25 g. These are cumulative readings, not separate ingredient weights.
The Quenel optical lot's registry key is vz_8Q-04a-Z9. The similar string vz_8O-04a-Z9 belongs to a retired jig and must not be used for the optical lot.

| Noma | 17.4 | Eren |
| Kesh | 23.8 | Uma |
The table depths are minimum safe depths, not water temperatures. Tavi authored the report, not the inspections.

cases.question: For Veyra with seal_mode engaged on a routine night shift, is purge_fast allowed? Is it allowed during the signed frost-drill window? Return the answer object with fields: routine_allowed, drill_allowed.
Veyra operators want a fast purge with the seal on: compare an ordinary overnight shift against a signed frost drill. Return the answer object with fields: routine_allowed, drill_allowed.
For Nacre, give the adopted archive database, whether RFC-K72 was adopted, and who proposed it. Return the answer object with fields: database, proposal_adopted, proposer.

Which database actually runs the Nacre archive after the rejected migration, did the migration pass, and who authored that suggestion? Return the answer object with fields: database, proposal_adopted, proposer.
What are the current worker_id and retry_mode for Lethra after release 2? Return the answer object with fields: worker_id, retry_mode.
Apply the narrow Lethra configuration revision: which worker serves now, and what retry policy survives? Return the answer object with fields: worker_id, retry_mode.
For the Orvi mixture, subtract successive cumulative readings. Give net resin and solvent amounts and their unit. Return the answer object with fields: resin, solvent, unit.
How much resin and how much solvent were added in Orvi, excluding the vessel mass? Include the measurement unit. Return the answer object with fields: resin, solvent, unit.
Return the exact Quenel optical lot registry_key, preserving case, punctuation, and the Q character. Return the answer object with fields: registry_key.
Which exact case-sensitive registry identifier belongs to the Quenel optical lot rather than its retired jig? Return the answer object with fields: registry_key.
From Sorrel's navigation report give Kesh's minimum safe depth in m, Kesh's inspector, and the report author. Return the answer object with fields: safe_depth_m, inspector, author.
Distinguish the Sorrel document signer from the person who inspected Kesh, and state that beacon's minimum safe depth in metres. Return the answer object with fields: safe_depth_m, inspector, author.
Identify the sole Pela probe anomalous sample, its exact fault_code, and its correction. Return the answer object with fields: sample, fault_code, correction.
Which Pela sample needs intervention, what diagnostic code was reported, and which corrective action applies? Return the answer object with fields: sample, fault_code, correction.

According only to the Tulven index, who is the keeper of the unqualified boat Aru, and what is Aru's launch date? Use null when ambiguous or undocumented. Return the answer object with fields: keeper, launch_date.
Without choosing between Tulven's two Aru boats, name its keeper and launch date if uniquely documented; otherwise use null. Return the answer object with fields: keeper, launch_date.
